about: CC-COMPAT (doc 84) - every Claude Code surface mokata depends on, and the oldest Claude Code version that provides it. The minimum version mokata states (doctor, README, docs) is DERIVED from this file: the newest `since` among the `core` surfaces. `opt-in` surfaces are checked only when their flag is wired. `since: null` means no source dates it; such an entry must say why it is still safe. Read by mokata.claude_code_version; validated weekly against the latest Claude Code by .github/workflows/cc-compat.yml.
